# antd-components
> antd-components is a collection of wrapped and enhanced Ant Design (antd) components for React applications. It provides production-ready components with additional features such as state management, form integration, and improved UX patterns.

All components are written in TypeScript and built on top of Ant Design 5.x. The library includes form components, data display components, upload solutions, and specialized UI elements optimized for real-world applications.

**Important notes for agents:**
- antd-components wraps Ant Design components with enhanced functionality
- All component names are prefixed with `Ac` (e.g., `AcInput`, `AcDatePicker`)
- Components support both class-based and functional component variants (e.g., `AcInputFc`)
- Form components integrate with `@ebay/nice-form-react` for schema-based form generation
- Components are located at `./packages/lib/src/lib/`
- The library is actively maintained with regular updates

## Documentation
- [Homepage](https://js.work): Official project homepage
- [Live Preview](https://afeiship.github.io/antd-components/): Interactive component showcase
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/afeiship/antd-components): Source code and issues
- [NPM Package](https://www.npmjs.org/package/@jswork/antd-components): Package information

## Key Features
- **Enhanced Ant Design Components:** Wrapper components with added functionality
- **State Management:** Built-in controlled component state handling
- **Form Integration:** Compatible with `@ebay/nice-form-react` for declarative forms
- **TypeScript Support:** Full type definitions with exported prop types
- **Multiple Variants:** Many components provide both class and functional variants
- **Upload Solutions:** Specialized upload components (dragger, picture, picture-card)
- **Table Utilities:** Enhanced table components with links and status switchers
- **Color Picker:** Returns hex color values (#ffcc00) for easy storage and display

## Installation

### Basic Installation
```bash
npm install -S @jswork/antd-components
```

### Dependencies
The library requires these peer dependencies:
- `antd` (Ant Design 5.x)
- `@ant-design/icons`
- `@ebay/nice-form-react`
- `react`
- `react-dom`
- `react-router-dom`

### Setup

1. **Import Styles:**
```scss
// CSS
@import "~@jswork/antd-components/dist/style.css";

// or SCSS
@import "~@jswork/antd-components/dist/style.scss";
```

2. **Import Components:**
```js
import { AcDatePicker, AcInput, AcButton } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';
import '@jswork/antd-components/dist/style.scss';

function App() {
  return (
    <div>
      <AcInput placeholder="Enter text..." />
      <AcDatePicker />
    </div>
  );
}
```

3. **Individual Component Import:**
```js
import { AcInput } from '@jswork/antd-components/dist/input';
```

## Component Reference

### Form Input Components

#### `AcInput`
Enhanced input component with controlled state and autoComplete handling.
```tsx
import { AcInput } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcInput
  value={text}
  onChange={({ target }) => setText(target.value)}
  autoComplete={true}
  placeholder="Enter text..."
/>
```

#### `AcTextarea`
Textarea component with auto-resize support.
```tsx
import { AcTextarea } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcTextarea
  value={content}
  onChange={({ target }) => setContent(target.value)}
  rows={4}
/>
```

#### `AcInputNumber`
Number input with validation and formatting.
```tsx
import { AcInputNumber } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcInputNumber
  value={number}
  onChange={({ target }) => setNumber(target.value)}
  min={0}
  max={100}
/>
```

#### `AcInputCopyable`
Input component with copy-to-clipboard functionality and optional link opener.
```tsx
import { AcInputCopyable } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

// Text type (default) - copyable only
<AcInputCopyable
  value={text}
  onChange={({ target }) => setText(target.value)}
/>

// Link type - copyable + open link button
<AcInputCopyable
  value="https://example.com"
  valueType="link"
  onChange={({ target }) => setText(target.value)}
/>
```

**Props:**
- `valueType?: 'text' | 'link'` - Display mode. Default: `'text'`
  - `text`: Shows copyable input only
  - `link`: Shows copyable input with link icon button to open URL in new tab

#### `AcInputToken`
Token-based input for managing tags/keywords.
```tsx
import { AcInputToken } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcInputToken
  value={tokens}
  onChange={({ target }) => setTokens(target.value)}
  placeholder="Add tags..."
/>
```

#### `AcMarkdownEditor`
Markdown editor with live preview.
```tsx
import { AcMarkdownEditor } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcMarkdownEditor
  value={markdown}
  onChange={({ target }) => setMarkdown(target.value)}
  placeholder="Write markdown..."
/>
```

#### `AcInputHidden`
Hidden input component for form data.
```tsx
import { AcInputHidden } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcInputHidden
  value={hiddenValue}
  onChange={({ target }) => setHiddenValue(target.value)}
/>
```

#### `AcInputTags`
Tag input component for managing multiple tags.
```tsx
import { AcInputTags } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcInputTags
  value={tags}
  onChange={({ target }) => setTags(target.value)}
/>
```

#### `AcColorPicker`
Color picker component that returns hex color values.
```tsx
import { AcColorPicker } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcColorPicker
  value={color}
  onChange={({ target }) => setColor(target.value)}
  allowClear
/>
// Returns hex format: #ffcc00
```

### Selection Components

#### `AcSelect`
Enhanced select dropdown with async support.
```tsx
import { AcSelect } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcSelect
  value={selected}
  onChange={({ target }) => setSelected(target.value)}
  items={[
    { value: '1', label: 'Option 1' },
    { value: '2', label: 'Option 2' }
  ]}
/>
```

#### `AcTreeSelect`
Tree-structured select component.
```tsx
import { AcTreeSelect } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcTreeSelect
  value={selected}
  onChange={({ target }) => setSelected(target.value)}
  items={treeData}
/>
```

#### `AcRadioGroup`
Radio button group component.
```tsx
import { AcRadioGroup } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcRadioGroup
  value={selected}
  onChange={({ target }) => setSelected(target.value)}
  items={[
    { value: 'a', label: 'Option A' },
    { value: 'b', label: 'Option B' }
  ]}
/>
```

#### `AcCheckbox` / `AcCheckboxGroup`
Checkbox and checkbox group components.
```tsx
import { AcCheckbox, AcCheckboxGroup } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcCheckboxGroup
  value={checkedValues}
  onChange={({ target }) => setCheckedValues(target.value)}
  items={[
    { value: '1', label: 'Check 1' },
    { value: '2', label: 'Check 2' }
  ]}
/>
```

#### `AcSwitch`
Toggle switch component.
```tsx
import { AcSwitch } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcSwitch
  value={enabled}
  onChange={({ target }) => setEnabled(target.value)}
/>
```

#### `AcSlider` / `AcSliderRange`
Slider and range slider components.
```tsx
import { AcSlider, AcSliderRange } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcSlider
  value={value}
  onChange={({ target }) => setValue(target.value)}
  min={0}
  max={100}
/>

<AcSliderRange
  value={[min, max]}
  onChange={({ target }) => setRange(target.value)}
/>
```

#### `AcRate`
Star rating component.
```tsx
import { AcRate } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcRate
  value={rating}
  onChange={({ target }) => setRating(target.value)}
/>
```

#### `AcTransfer`
Transfer list component for moving items between lists.
```tsx
import { AcTransfer } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcTransfer
  value={targetKeys}
  onChange={({ target }) => setTargetKeys(target.value)}
  items={items}
/>
```

### Date & Time Components

#### `AcDatePicker`
Date picker component with various formats.
```tsx
import { AcDatePicker } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcDatePicker
  value={date}
  onChange={({ target }) => setSelectedDate(target.value)}
  format="YYYY-MM-DD"
/>
```

#### `AcTimePicker`
Time picker component.
```tsx
import { AcTimePicker } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcTimePicker
  value={time}
  onChange={({ target }) => setSelectedTime(target.value)}
  format="HH:mm"
/>
```

#### `AcRangePicker`
Date range picker component.
```tsx
import { AcRangePicker } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcRangePicker
  value={[start, end]}
  onChange={({ target }) => setDateRange(target.value)}
/>
```

### Upload Components

#### `AcUpload`
Base upload component with enhanced features.
```tsx
import { AcUpload } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcUpload
  value={files}
  onChange={({ target }) => setFiles(target.value)}
  action="/api/upload"
/>
```

#### `AcUploadDragger`
Drag-and-drop upload zone.
```tsx
import { AcUploadDragger } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcUploadDragger
  value={files}
  onChange={({ target }) => setFiles(target.value)}
  action="/api/upload"
/>
```

#### `AcUploadPicture`
Picture upload component with preview.
```tsx
import { AcUploadPicture } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcUploadPicture
  value={imageUrl}
  onChange={({ target }) => setImageUrl(target.value)}
  action="/api/upload"
/>
```

#### `AcUploadPictureCard`
Card-style picture upload component.
```tsx
import { AcUploadPictureCard } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcUploadPictureCard
  value={images}
  onChange={({ target }) => setImages(target.value)}
  action="/api/upload"
/>
```

### Data Display Components

#### `AcTable` / `AcTableLinks` / `AcTableStatusSwitcher` / `AcTableToggleSwitcher`
Enhanced table components with additional features.
```tsx
import {
  AcTable,
  AcTableLinks,
  AcTableStatusSwitcher,
  AcTableToggleSwitcher
} from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcTable
  columns={columns}
  dataSource={data}
  pagination={false}
/>

<AcTableLinks
  columns={columns}
  dataSource={data}
  linkField="url"
/>

<AcTableStatusSwitcher
  columns={columns}
  dataSource={data}
  statusField="status"
  onStatusChange={(record, status) => handleStatusChange(record, status)}
/>
```

#### `AcTree`
Tree component for hierarchical data.
```tsx
import { AcTree } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcTree
  items={treeData}
  onSelect={(keys) => setSelectedKeys(keys)}
/>
```

#### `AcCardExtras`
Card component with extra actions and features.
```tsx
import { AcCardExtras } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcCardExtras
  title="Card Title"
  extra={<ActionButtons />}
>
  Card content
</AcCardExtras>
```

### Tag Components

#### `AcCheckableTag` / `AcCheckableTagList` / `AcEditableTagGroup`
Tag components with various interaction patterns.
```tsx
import {
  AcCheckableTag,
  AcCheckableTagList,
  AcEditableTagGroup
} from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcCheckableTag
  value={checked}
  onChange={({ target }) => setChecked(target.value)}
>
  Tag Label
</AcCheckableTag>

<AcCheckableTagList
  value={selectedTags}
  onChange={({ target }) => setSelectedTags(target.value)}
  items={[
    { value: 'tag1', label: 'Tag1' },
    { value: 'tag2', label: 'Tag2' },
    { value: 'tag3', label: 'Tag3' }
  ]}
/>

<AcEditableTagGroup
  value={tags}
  onChange={({ target }) => setTags(target.value)}
/>
```

### Other Components

#### `AcButton` / `AcConfirmButton`
Button components with confirmation support.
```tsx
import { AcButton, AcConfirmButton } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcButton
  type="primary"
  onClick={handleClick}
>
  Click Me
</AcButton>

<AcConfirmButton
  onConfirm={handleDelete}
  confirmTitle="Are you sure?"
>
  Delete
</AcConfirmButton>
```

#### `AcSearch`
Search input component with enhanced features.
```tsx
import { AcSearch } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcSearch
  value={searchTerm}
  onChange={({ target }) => setSearchTerm(target.value)}
  onSearch={({ target }) => handleSearch(target.value)}
  placeholder="Search..."
/>
```

#### `AcExtraSearch`
Extended search component with URL sync support.
```tsx
import { AcExtraSearch } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcExtraSearch
  name="search"
  queryKey="keywords"
  routerType="hash"
/>
```

#### `AcAlert`
Alert notification component.
```tsx
import { AcAlert } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcAlert
  type="info"
  message="Alert message"
  description="Detailed description"
/>
```

#### `AcBreadcrumb`
Breadcrumb navigation component.
```tsx
import { AcBreadcrumb } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcBreadcrumb
  items={[
    { title: 'Home', path: '/' },
    { title: 'Page', path: '/page' }
  ]}
/>
```

#### `AcCodeFlask`
Code editor component based on CodeFlask.
```tsx
import { AcCodeFlask } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcCodeFlask
  value={code}
  onChange={(code) => setCode(code)}
  language="javascript"
/>
```

#### `AcInteractiveList`
Interactive list component with actions.
```tsx
import { AcInteractiveList } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcInteractiveList
  items={items}
  renderItem={(item) => (
    <div>
      <span>{item.title}</span>
      <button onClick={() => handleAction(item)}>Action</button>
    </div>
  )}
/>
```

#### `AcCheckableDropdown`
Dropdown with checkable options.
```tsx
import { AcCheckableDropdown } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcCheckableDropdown
  value={selectedItems}
  onChange={({ target }) => setSelectedItems(target.value)}
  items={dropdownOptions}
/>
```

#### `AcFormActions`
Form action buttons component.
```tsx
import { AcFormActions } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcFormActions
  onSubmit={handleSubmit}
  onCancel={handleCancel}
/>
```

#### `AcPreSelect`
Pre-selection component for advanced selection patterns.
```tsx
import { AcPreSelect } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

<AcPreSelect
  value={selection}
  onChange={({ target }) => setSelection(target.value)}
  items={availableOptions}
/>
```

## Template Components

Located in `./packages/lib/src/tpls/`, these are higher-level templates for common patterns:

- `breadcrumb/index.tsx` - Breadcrumb template
- `kv/index.tsx` - Key-value display template
- `raw/index.tsx` - Raw content template
- `transfer/index.tsx` - Transfer template

## Usage Notes for Agents

### Component Naming Convention
- All components use the `Ac` prefix (e.g., `AcInput`, `AcDatePicker`)
- Functional variants use `Fc` suffix (e.g., `AcInputFc`)
- Prop types are exported as `Ac[ComponentName]Props` (e.g., `AcInputProps`)

### Import Patterns
```js
// Import all components
import { AcInput, AcDatePicker } from '@jswork/antd-components/main';

// Import individual component
import { AcInput } from '@jswork/antd-components/dist/input';

// Import prop types
import type { AcInputProps } from '@jswork/antd-components/dist/input';
```

### Form Integration
Components integrate with `@ebay/nice-form-react` using static `formSchema` property:
```js
AcInput.formSchema = 'ac-input';  // Component identifier
```

### Event Handling Pattern
Most components use a standardized event pattern:
```tsx
// onChange receives { target: { value } }
onChange={({ target }) => {
  console.log(target.value);  // New value
}}
```

### State Management
Components maintain internal state and support controlled/uncontrolled modes:
```tsx
// Controlled mode
<AcInput value={value} onChange={handleChange} />

// Uncontrolled mode (initial value only)
<AcInput defaultValue="initial" />
```

### Development
```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Build library
npm run build

# Run examples
npm run dev:example

# Publish release
npm run release
```
